name: OneLove R ~ONE LOVE Recover~
source:
This is a story of the sisters in next ten years appeared in the previous ONE LOVE.
Their love is about to be broken.....by a single man.
Forbidden incest sex of a man and his daughter..... sibling sex...... In the immoral, who will you love and who will you dump...?
It is all up to you.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE028571.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是上一部《ONE LOVE》中出现的姐妹俩未来十年的故事。
他们的爱情即将被一个单身男人打破。
禁止的男人和女儿的乱伦性行为……兄弟姐妹性行为……在不道德的事情中，你会爱谁，又会抛弃谁……？
这一切都取决于你。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE028571.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
